initial_events.description: Warm up the reservoir on these events before generating, instead of the whole vocabulary (the default for a fresh model). Tokens must belong to the model's vocabulary. Ignored when continuing from a `state` that is itself a prior qrc-gen-v1 output, unless given explicitly to deliberately re-seed the trajectory.
initial_events.title: Initial Events

random_seed.description: RNG seed for this call's own generation randomness (softmax sampling) — applied after the model is loaded, not the seed the QRC was trained with (that one is always reused exactly, to reconstruct the reservoir faithfully). None = keep whatever RNG state the model already has (deterministic given the same inputs); give a value to force a specific, reproducible sampling trajectory.
random_seed.title: Random Seed

shots.description: Measurement shots during generation (backend.shots). None = keep whatever shots the model was trained (or last generated) with.
shots.title: Shots

variation.description: Sampling temperature: low = deterministic/repetitive, high = random
variation.title: Variation

vocabulary.description: Relabel the model's output space: the trained reservoir/readout only depend on vocabulary *size*, not identity, so any vocabulary with the same number of distinct tokens as the model's own can be swapped in — generation then emits from this vocabulary instead. A different size raises `incompatible_model` (readout shape mismatch).
vocabulary.title: Vocabulary

outputFiles.name: state
outputFiles.description: Updated reservoir state; chain into a further qrc-gen-v2 call via input_files.state.
